opening.argument: The material presents a rapid AVAX-profit process built around a smart contract and a flashloan function. The title promotes a “Flash loans Attack On Pancakeswap” as a way to earn free AVAX, while the instructions require viewers to “Send $200 of Avalanche/AVAX to the contract for gas fee for all swaps” and “Call ‘flashloan’ function in Remix.” The stated mechanism is that “the rapid trading inflates the coins value and that inflated value is where we generate the profit,” attributing the apparent return to inflating a newly created token. The speaker then reports an apparent result after describing the process, although the wording is garbled and does not support a precise profit figure. The risk warning does not remove this direct promotion of a high-return process requiring an AVAX transfer.
